title: The Value of Personal Data in Internet Commerce: A High-Stakes Field Experiment on Data Regulation Policy
authors: Tianshu Sun; Zhe Yuan; Chunxiao Li; Kaifu Zhang; Jun Xu
eligible_reason: No DiD. Randomized field experiment on the Alibaba homepage recommender (personal-data ban for a random subset of 555,800 customers); cross-sectional OLS of outcomes on is_testgroup with customer-characteristic dummies and HTE interactions. The text explicitly contrasts this with prior DiD studies of data regulation.
